description.value: Wind Cries Mary is a west coast bar and restaurant tucked into 45 Bastion Square in Victoria's downtown core, built around a nose-to-tail menu that draws on local Vancouver Island farmers, foragers, fishmongers, and winemakers. The ever-changing sharing menu is complemented by a full bar program of local wines and craft cocktails. Outdoor seating is available on a front patio and in a hidden courtyard.
